title: Figure 15: MCap Specific Energy and Estimated Costs vs. fGMC
description: Log-log chart with fGMC (1E+06 to 1E+11) on the x-axis, MCap attainable energy density (Wh/g) on the left axis and MCap projected nominal cost ($/Wh) on the right axis. A rising blue line from 'Mcap nanocell #1' to 'Mcap nanocell #2' crosses a falling red cost line, with markers for 'Production target initial', fuel cell and Li-ion energy density levels, and Li-ion and Pb-Acid price levels; a 'Trend' arrow is shown. Text states a mass production target of fGMC ~10^9 would exceed lithium-ion specific energy at reduced cost.
